title: AI's Hidden History: Developed for Disabilities First! #shorts
description: Did you know most major AI breakthroughs were first developed for people with disabilities? From reading machines for the blind to voice synthesis, these technologies paved the way for innovations we use daily. #AI #AssistiveTech #Innovation #DisabilityInclusion #Technology
